newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's BoP surplus rises to $221.1 mln in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's BoP surplus rises to $221.1 mln in Nov.

text.p: Lebanon had a $221.1 million balance of payments surplus in November compared with $141.1 million in October, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
This brought the BoP surplus for the year to date to $684.6 million against $147 million for the same period in 1995, the central bank added.
"This improvement in the Balance of Payments is due to sustained capital inflows that covered the trade deficit," the Bank said.

Note - Figures in millions of U.S. dollars
